title: Hatch a Pet
description: Hatch your egg into a pet and keep it in your inventory.

giver.name: Odessa Quill
giver.text: Hold the egg, right-click, and see what comes out. Rarity is rolled when it hatches: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic or Legendary. Higher rarity means stronger stats.

objectives.label: Have a pet in your inventory

rewards.hint: Open the Pets page in the K menu to bring it along.
